honesty_notes.dimensionality: electrochemical_carbon_fixation resolves a 1-D proton electrodiffusion barrier plus a single well-mixed Fe/Ni/S reaction interface. H2/DIC/formate are well-mixed feeds/pools, not spatial fields; a 2-D multi-solute pore map is a model extension (future sim), not a re-run, so it is flagged rather than fabricated.
honesty_notes.control: no-catalyst null uses catalyst_active=1e-6, NOT 0.0 (bigraph-schema is_empty backfill). The proton diffusion field is geochemically set and is correctly catalyst-independent; the collapse is in the REACTION (net carbon flux + products), proving the null is genuine.
honesty_notes.yields: product pools are lab-calibrated Preiner-2020/Altair-2025 CEILINGS gated by the catalyst, deterministic (no error bars, none fabricated); the spatial panel shows the computed field, it does not turn the calibrated ceilings into a prediction.
honesty_notes.field_steady: the proton electrodiffusion field equilibrates within the first step (fast relative to the reaction), so the three field time points are near-identical by construction -- a real result, not a rendering shortcut; the genuine time dependence is the product accumulation.
honesty_notes.gate: figure is descriptive; it does NOT change any arm verdict or the study gate.
